notes.title: Official full launch
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone for providing feedback and suggestions during our Early Access period.  The full version of the game is now available.

If you encounter any issues with the game from here on, please drop us a line at support@virtualescapes.ca and we'll get back to you as quickly as possible.

Thanks again!

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.notes:
Thanks to all the Early Access testers for their help and suggestions. I've addressed most of the issues in this new  release.  In particular...

[list]
[*] Some people were having trouble picking up small objects that fell onto the floor, so I've made the trigger volume larger on those items
[*] Added a slight click when the combination lock is reset
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause the fuel tank to float in mid-air under certain circumstances
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed you to reach through the cage to get the fuel tank
[*] The elevator is now triggered by touching the button panel, rather than just entering the elevator
[*] The elevator now moves twice as fast
[*] Added a voice announcement when you enter the laser maze, since the sign wasn't obvious to everyone
[*] Attempting to throw objects across the laser maze will now cause them to get zapped by the lasers and thrown back
[/list]

If you have additional suggestions or feedback, please send it to support@virtualescapes.ca and we'll try to respond quickly.

Thanks again, everyone!

notes.title: We've launched!
notes.notes:
"Escape the Bunker" is now available on Steam Early Access.

After a long period of beta-testing and a lot of great feedback, we're ready for a larger audience.

If you encounter any issues, please send email to support@virtualescapes.ca and we'll try to respond promptly.

Thanks, and we hope you enjoy the game!
